name: Baohuang
summary: Five-player Chinese climbing game where the emperor and hidden eunuch partner against three farmers to shed cards first.
rules_text: Use 168 cards: four decks minus 3s-5s plus 8 jokers. Mark one red joker as emperor, one black joker as eunuch. Five players draw from a face-down stack anticlockwise, getting 33-34 cards. Holder of emperor card is emperor, known, but may pass it left until someone accepts. Holder of eunuch card is emperor's secret partner vs other three. Before play, any non-emperor may declare side (uprising) to double score; emperor alone playing with both marks may declare alone to double. Emperor leads any single or equal-rank set, optionally with jokers attached, or any jokers. In turn anticlockwise players must pass or play same number of cards all higher rank-for-rank. Red joker is highest, then black joker, then 2-A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6. Play containing red joker is unbeatable. When all four pass, last player leads anew. Team that empties hands first wins; losers give highest non-jokers as tribute next deal.
